title: brainstorm: 规整下载站点架构与扩展流程
creator: Mabel-WIN
notes: 2026-03-30: The architecture foundation landed in commit eae2f48. Follow-up provider migration landed in 45f7b23 for Bilibili, Twitter/X, and Xiaohongshu. Cross-layer payload slimming and runtime-owned site-hint normalization landed in 2fb72d8 with backward-compatible video_selected_v2 support. Candidate ordering authority now lives in runtime normalization, so background no longer reorders platform candidates before queueing. Remaining work focuses on long-term video_selected_v2 consolidation, broader provider fixtures/e2e coverage, and deferred cleanup of historical Pinterest sidecar assets/docs.
